turns.text: I can send you a list. I've been keeping a spreadsheet since the first week of the month.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That helps. I'll take it to the team and see what we can find out. I can't promise a fix today, but I'll get it looked at.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: I appreciate that. The thing is, this affects how I think about the renewal.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Go on.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: If our after-hours calls keep getting mislabeled, we'll have to look at other options before January. I don't want to, but I have to bring our leadership something that works.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: I'll make sure this gets the right attention. On the rest of the account, how are things tracking?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Call volume is about where we expected, maybe a little higher. The PreSense screen pops have been fine for the agents.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Good. And Google Ads Smart Bidding?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That's fine too. Our bids are holding steady.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Any changes coming on your side before the new year?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: We're adding a third shift at the north branch in November, so a few more seats might come up. I'll confirm once the schedule's locked.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Let me know and I'll update the paperwork. Does the fifteenth still work for the renewal call?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Should be fine. My calendar's open that morning.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: I'll send an invite. And send me that spreadsheet when you can, I'll dig into the weekend calls.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Will do. Thanks, [PERSON_2].

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Talk soon, [PERSON_1].

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Morning [PERSON_1]. How's you know, Denver treating you? Getting cold up there yet?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Hey [PERSON_2]. Yeah, it dropped to like thirty overnight. Uh, I had to scrape my windshield for the first time this season.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: You know, Not ready for it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Ha, I bet. I saw flurries in the forecast for you all. Anyway, thanks for making time. I know this is the renewal window, so I figured we could just walk through it together.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: You know, yeah, that's what I'm here for. I've got the numbers in front of me. Give me a sec, I'm pulling up the sheet.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: No rush.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Okay. So before we get into the actual terms, I need to flag something that came out of our our finance review.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: It's not a dealbreaker, but it's going to come up.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Sure, go ahead.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: So, um, the way the pricing is structured right now, um, we're paying for the base uh, call tracking, and then everything that actually makes it useful is a separate line item.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Signal AI is tacked on like it's an extra, PreSense is its own thing, the QM seats are per seat, and then the AI Voice Agent is billed by the minute.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: When you add it all up, it's not small.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Okay, so the concern is that the add-ons are stacking. Is that the finance team's read, or is it more about how it's it's presented?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Honestly? Both. My CFO looked at it and said, 'Why are we paying extra for the intelligence layer on top of the thing that's supposed to be the intelligence platform?' Signal AI being an add-on on top of call tracking is the one that gets him the most.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Got it. Let me ask, is this coming from a budget uh, number they've already set, or is it more of a benchmarking thing?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: A bit of both. We're at about nine twenty a year, and they want to see that come down or at least be justified line by line.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: I don't have a target number yet, but I need something to take back.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Okay. That's really helpful. I don't want I mean, to react on the the spot, but let me take that back to our team and see what's possible.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: I'll come back to you with something concrete.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That's all I'm asking. I just don't want to get to March and be surprised.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Understood. Before we go further, how's everything else running? I I saw your call volume ticked up last month. You're north of two hundred thousand calls a month now, right?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Yeah, about two fifteen last month. We added a couple of markets in the Southwest, so it's been busy. My team's stretched thin, honestly.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: We had someone out on leave, so the routing configs got a little messy for a few weeks.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That's a lot of volume. Is the Genesys side holding up okay with the screen pops?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That's actually the other thing. The PreSense pops are fine when they show up, but we've had a couple of instances where a call transfers and the screen pop either doesn't fire on the second leg or it fires to the wrong agent.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: It's happened twice this quarter, both times on high-value sales calls.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Twice this quarter, and both on sales calls. Do you have the call IDs or timestamps for those?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: I don't have them handy, but I can get them from my ops lead. His name is [PERSON_3]. Uh, He's the one who flagged it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Okay, send me what he has and I'll open it up with our support team. I'm not going to guess at what's causing it, but I want to make sure it's on the radar before we talk renewal again.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Appreciate that. Like I said, it's not constant, but when it happens, the agent's sitting there with no context, and the caller's already annoyed.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Makes sense. Okay, let me get those details and then we can schedule a follow-up. Does next Thursday work? Uh, Same time?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Thursday's good. I'll get [PERSON_3]'s notes over to to you by Tuesday so you have time to look.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: I mean, Perfect. And on the pricing side, I'll bring something back to you by then too. I can't promise what it'll look like, but I'll have an answer.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That's fine. One more thing, and this is minor. Uh, your Adobe Analytics connector, is that still pulling in the campaign data the way it should?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: We haven't touched it in months.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Yeah, so, that's been solid. No issues on our end.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Good. And Google Ads offline conversions are still flowing? Because we're in the middle of Q4 and I don't want that to break.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Those are both fine. I checked uh, before the call. Nothing flagged.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Okay, good. Sorry, one tangent. Did you all ever get that new hire in support? I remember you mentioning someone was starting.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: We did, yeah. She started two weeks ago, so that should help with turnaround times. I'll make sure your ticket gets to the the right person.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Great. That's all I've got, [PERSON_2]. Thanks for hearing me out on the pricing stuff.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Of course. I'll talk to you Thursday. Stay warm out there.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Like, Ha, I'll try. Talk soon.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Hi both, thanks for making time. How's the week going in Columbus?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Busy. We're in the middle of open enrollment for the small group book, but the contact center side has been steady.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Steady is one word for it. We're right around 11,400 calls a week across claims and policy service, up maybe 4% over last month.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That tracks with what I saw in the dashboard. Is the after-hours claims pilot still where you want it, or are you tweaking hours?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Still 6pm to 8am and weekends. The Voice Agent is picking up about 62% of those without a transfer now, which is better than I expected three weeks in.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: And the transcripts are landing in Genesys and Salesforce the way we hoped, so the adjusters aren't chasing notes.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Good. Any staffing changes I should note for the QM scorecards?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: We've got two new team leads starting Monday, so I'll need their QM seats turned on. I'll send their names over after this.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Perfect. And [PERSON_2], how's the distribution side looking heading into Q4?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Fine. The Google Ads offline conversions are still matching well, and Adobe is showing the campaign attribution we need. Nothing urgent there.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Okay. Anything from the pilot team you want me to capture while we're all on the line?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Actually, yeah. One thing keeps coming up from our compliance folks, and it's worth putting in front of your product team.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Go ahead.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: On the claims side, our transcripts and the AI summaries can still carry things like policy numbers, dates of birth, and driver's license numbers.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Our compliance group wants redaction we can configure ourselves, not a fixed setting, so we can decide what gets masked in transcripts and summaries and who on our side is allowed to see the unmasked version.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: So configurable redaction of identifiers, with role-based access tied to it?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Right, and audit so we can show who viewed what. The other piece is retention. We'd want transcripts to auto-delete after a set period we choose, say 90 days for the after-hours claims calls, and have that run on its own.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That last part matters for our state filings. If we can set the window ourselves and prove it's enforced, that's a much easier conversation with the auditors.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Got it. Is this specific to the Voice Agent calls, or does it apply to live-agent calls too?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Both, honestly. The after-hours pilot is where it surfaced, but the same rules should hold for anything a licensed agent handles.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: How urgent is it? I want to set the right expectation internally.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Medium. Nothing is on fire, but our next internal audit window is early next year, so it would be good to have an answer before then.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That's helpful. I'll write it up with the examples you gave and take it to the product team. I can't promise a date, but I'll come back with what I hear.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: That's all I'm asking.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: One more scheduling thing. Can we move the November review? The second week is heavy for us.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Sure. I'll send a couple of options for the week after. And I'll get the two QM seats provisioned once I have the names.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: I'll send them today.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Anything else on the pilot you want me to look at before then?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: No, the rest is running fine. Call volumes, routing, all good.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Great. I'll follow up with the write-up and the scheduling options by Monday. Thanks, both.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Thanks, [PERSON_1].

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Appreciate it. Talk soon.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Hi [PERSON_1], how are you doing today?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Hey [PERSON_2], I'm good. Busy week. How about you?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Same here. I wanted to check in on how things are going with call tracking and Signal AI across the practices.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Anything standing out?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Mostly good. Call volumes look normal for October, maybe a little up with the fall promos. The practice managers are still opening their call summaries every morning, so that habit stuck.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That's what we like to hear. Any changes on your side staffing wise? I know you had someone out for a bit.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Yeah, one of our front desk leads at the Meridian office was out for two weeks, so the Boise team covered phones.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Things are back to normal now.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Good. And are you still running the new patient campaign through Google Ads?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: We are, that's the main driver. Which is actually why I wanted to talk to you today. We've got an issue with the offline conversions going to Google Ads.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Okay, tell me what you're seeing.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: So the call conversions are landing in Google Ads, but they show up one to three days after the call. Sometimes two days, sometimes three.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: It's not consistent.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: And that timing is a problem because?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Because Smart Bidding is making decisions on partial data. If it doesn't know about half the new patient calls for two days, it's optimizing on an incomplete picture.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: We're spending real money on those campaigns.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That makes sense. Have you checked anything on your end?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: We did. We went through the GCLID capture and the Invoca tag, everything looks right. Nothing changed on our side. I even had our web person double check the tag placement.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: So we're kind of stuck.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Got it. Do you know when this started? Roughly?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Maybe three weeks ago. I noticed it when I was pulling the weekly report and the numbers looked thin, then caught up later.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Okay. Does it affect all campaigns or just certain ones?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: As far as I can tell it's all of them, but I haven't looked at every single one. The new patient ones are the ones I watch closest.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Let me take this back to the team and find out what's going on with the delivery timing. I'll want to look at a couple of specific calls, so can you send me two or three examples with the call times?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Yes, I can pull those together this afternoon.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Perfect. In the meantime, everything else on the Signal AI side is fine?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Yeah, no complaints there.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Good. One more thing, we should set up a short call before your next quarterly review. Does the first week of November work?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Let's do the fourth if that works. I'll send an invite.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Sounds good. I'll follow up on the conversion timing as soon as I hear back. Talk soon.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Thanks, [PERSON_2]. Bye.

turns.text: We've got two custom objects for Medicare Advantage dispositions and one for P&C referrals. Those are the ones that go dark.

turns.text: When did you last see it happen?

turns.text: Someone touched it. I rebuilt the mapping from scratch and it started working again. Took me most of a day.

turns.text: Same here. Before we get into anything, how's the weather down in Charlotte? Starting to feel like fall up my way.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Yeah, finally. We had a couple of mornings in the forties this week. Which is nice for us, honestly, because the heating calls start picking up.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That's what I figured. Is the seasonal swing showing up yet?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: It's starting. September was pretty flat, but October is tracking maybe fifteen percent above September on total call volume. The Raleigh and Durham branches are seeing it first.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Okay. Anything on your end that needs attention from me, or is this more of a housekeeping call?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Mostly housekeeping. I wanted to lock in a couple of dates for the team.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Sure. What do you have in mind?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: We're onboarding six new dispatchers in November. Two of them start the second week, four the week after. I'd like to get them into a basic session on the platform before they're on the phones.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Makes sense. Do you want one combined session or two separate ones?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Two, I think. The ones starting later would be sitting through it two weeks early otherwise.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Okay. What days work for you? I can do the eleventh and the eighteenth if that lines up.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Let me check. The eighteenth works. For the first group, could we do the tenth instead of the eleventh? We have a branch managers meeting on the eleventh.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: The tenth is open. I'll send invites for the tenth and the eighteenth, both at ten in the morning your time. Does that work?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That works. I'll forward them to the branch leads so they know.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Perfect. Anything else on the user side? I saw we had a couple of seats that look inactive.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Yeah, two people left in September, and we hired replacements. The seat count stays the same, so nothing to change there. I just need to get the new folks set up.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Okay. Send me their names and email addresses and I'll get them added before the training.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Will do. Probably by Monday.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: No rush. Anything coming up on the marketing side I should know about?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: We're doing a fall tune-up promotion starting the first week of November. Mostly paid search and some social. Nothing unusual, just more volume on the same campaigns.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Got it. Is [PERSON_3] still running the paid search?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: She is. She's out this week, but she'll be back Monday.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Good to know. If anything comes up with the campaign structure while she's out, just let me know.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Will do.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Last thing from me. Do you want to keep the same monthly check-in time through the end of the year, or shift it around the holidays?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Let's keep it. Second and fourth Friday works fine for me.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Okay, I'll leave it on the calendar. I'll send the training invites today and follow up Monday on the new users.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Sounds good. Thanks, [PERSON_2].

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Talk soon, [PERSON_1]. Have a good weekend.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: You too.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: Brightline Home Services / Invoca | exec sponsor | Fri, Oct 23, 2026

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Morning, [PERSON_1]. How's the week going?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Morning. Busy. We're in shoulder season so the HVAC side is steady but plumbing is picking up. How about you?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Same, same. I saw call volume ticked up about six percent last month across the branches. Anything unusual on your end?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: No, that tracks. We added two techs in Raleigh and one in Greensboro, so the routing feels better. Still, I wanted to talk through a couple of things that came up this week.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Sure. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: First one is on the Google Ads side. The offline conversions we send from Invoca are landing in Google one to three days after the call. So Smart Bidding is optimizing on data that's already stale by the time it gets there.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Okay, so the conversions are delayed. Is that every call or just some?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Looks like most of them. I noticed it in the weekly numbers because our cost per booked job was creeping up even though call quality looked fine. Then our CMO pulled the report and asked why the bid strategy was leaning so hard on the cheap stuff.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Got it. And when did you first see the lag?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Maybe three weeks ago. I didn't flag it right away because I thought it was a Google reporting delay. But it's consistent.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Let me pull the integration logs and check the timestamps on our side. I'll get back to you by Tuesday with what I find. Does that work?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Tuesday's fine. The other thing is bigger. Finance and procurement went line by line through this year versus last year, and they're pushing back on paying separately for PreSense, QM seats, AI Voice Agent minutes. They want one number at renewal.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: I hear that. When you say one number, are they asking for a bundle or just a single line item?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Honestly, either. They don't want to see add-ons stacked on top of the base. They compared the two invoices and the delta was mostly the add-ons. So now every conversation about renewal starts with that.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Okay. I can bring that to our pricing team and see what options exist. I can't promise anything today, but I'll take it back.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That's all I'm asking. Just don't come back with a three percent increase and call it a bundle.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Noted. Anything else on your list?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: No, that's it. PreSense has been fine since we turned it on. The agents like the screen pop.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Good. I'll also check in with your ops lead about the Q1 staffing plan. I know you mentioned adding hours in the Charlotte branch.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Yeah, we're still figuring that out. Probably early December before we post the req.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Okay. I'll send a calendar note for a check-in the first week of November, and I'll have an update on the Google Ads timing by Tuesday.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Perfect. Thanks, [PERSON_2].

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Talk soon.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Morning, [PERSON_1]. How's the week treating you up in Tacoma?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Oh, you know. Rain since Monday. My commute's been a swim. How about you?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Same story down here, minus the ferry. I saw the Mariners thing on your LinkedIn, that member event looked fun.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: It was. We had a booth at the Tacoma fall festival, and honestly half the people who stopped by just wanted the free tote bags.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Um, Classic. Okay, so I know we've got a short window. I wanted to to check in ahead of renewal season and hear how things are sitting with you and the team.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Yeah. Overall the platform's doing what we need. Call volumes have been steady, we're around nine thousand a month across the the branches and the lending line, little bump when rates move.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That tracks with what I see on the tracking numbers. Anything shift on the staffing side since summer?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: We finally filled the two member service rep roles on the evening shift. Took four I mean, months. Uh, so the queue's breathing again, which is nice.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Good. I I know that was a grind.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Mm. And the QM side, we're still scoring everything, compliance reviews every scorecard change before it goes live, so that process is slow but it's working.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Understood. No changes to the scorecards since we last talked?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: No, not right now. It's fine. Honestly, the thing that's actually on my plate um, is the renewal conversation. And it's not really coming from me.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Okay. Tell me more.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: So finance and procurement have been going through every vendor contract since the third quarter. And they've landed on this idea that they don't want to keep paying separately for things that feel like add-ons. PreSense, the QM seats, AI Voice Agent minutes, all of it. They want one bundled price. One number on the page.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Got it. And is that a hard line from them, or is it more of a preference going into the negotiation?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: It's It's pretty firm. I I sat in a meeting Tuesday, and the procurement lead, her name's [PERSON_3], she said she doesn't want to see four line items on a renewal.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: She wants to see I mean, one. So when the renewal comes up in February, that's the shape they're expecting.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That's helpful. Can I ask, is it the total dollar amount that's the issue, or the structure?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Structure, mostly. The number itself we can work with. It's the feeling that every time we turn around there's another meter running.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That's what they're reacting to.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Okay. I don't want to promise anything on the spot, because packaging isn't something I set. What I can do is take this to our deal desk with the specifics, the seat count, the minutes, and the PreSense usage, and see what a bundled structure could look like.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That's all I'm asking. I just need something to put in front of [PERSON_3] that doesn't look like a phone bill.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Fair. When do you need it by?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: If I could have something by mid-November, that gives me room before the holidays.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Mid-November works. Uh, Let me get the usage numbers from our side first so I'm not guessing. I'll email you a summary by Wednesday and then we can get on a call with whoever needs to be on it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Perfect. And [PERSON_2], just so you know, I'm not trying to squeeze anyone. I like working with you. This is [PERSON_3]'s process, not mine.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: I know. And I'd rather hear it now than in February.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Right. Oh, one other thing. Our Salesforce admin, [PERSON_4], she's rolling out some new reporting for the you know, member experience team, so if you get questions from her about call data fields, that's what it's about.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Um, Good to know. I'll keep an eye out.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: And the Google Ads side is uh, still plugging along. Nothing new there.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Great. Anything else before I let you go?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: No, that's the uh, big one. Thanks for hearing me out.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Of course. I'll get you that summary Wednesday, and we'll talk packaging after that.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Sounds good. Stay dry.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: You too. Talk soon, [PERSON_1].

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: Ridgeway Motor Group / Invoca | exec sponsor | Fri, Oct 23, 2026

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Morning, both. Thanks for making time. How's the store this week?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Busy. We're up, I think, twenty five percent in inbound calls over last October. Football season always does that to us.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: It's mostly the F-150 stuff off the two Tulsa stores. The Broken Arrow store is quieter but they always are.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Got it. And how are you staffed through the month?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Two BDC agents out the first week of November, so I'm shifting one of the night folks to days for a bit. It'll be fine.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Okay. I'll keep an eye on volume alerts in case staffing changes what shows up on the scorecard.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Appreciate it. While we're here, I want to walk through something the agency flagged.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Sure, go ahead.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: So our paid search agency, they pull the Google Ads account every Monday. Last Monday they asked why our call conversions land in batches, like eight on Monday, three Tuesday, none Wednesday, then eleven Thursday.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Like delayed?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Delayed and lumpy. I went in and looked at a call from Wednesday last week, the fourteenth, and the conversion didn't show in Google Ads until Friday the sixteenth. So one to three days.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: That's not great when we're making bid decisions daily.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Right. Smart Bidding is optimizing on an incomplete picture. If Tuesday's calls aren't in yet, the system thinks Tuesday was a bad day and it thins out the campaigns we actually want.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Okay. So the call attribution itself is fine, it's the write to Google Ads that's running behind.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: As far as I can tell, yeah. The calls show in Invoca same day. The conversions, they're the stragglers.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Do you know if this started around a specific date?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Honestly, I don't. The agency noticed it maybe two, three weeks ago, but I couldn't tell you when it began.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Okay. I want to take that back with the dates you gave me and get a real answer, not a guess. Is there a report in Google Ads they can send me?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Yeah, I'll have them export the conversion times and email it to you. Probably this afternoon.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Perfect. And the calls that did convert, any pattern? Certain stores, certain campaigns?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: I didn't spot one. Seemed like everything.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Alright. Let me get that in front of the team and I'll come back to you with something concrete.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Can I add something to that?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Please.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: My boss, the VP of sales, is already asking whether we renew in January. And I'm not going to tell her yes if our conversions are landing in Google Ads late.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Understood.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: The BDC runs off those numbers. If we can't trust the timing on the Google Ads side, it makes the whole renewal conversation harder than it needs to be.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: I hear that, and I don't want to guess at it either. Let me get the agency's timing report and take it to the team. I'll have an update for you by early next week.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: That works.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: [PERSON_2], can you get me the agency's contact too? I'd rather hear it from them than secondhand.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Yeah, I'll send it over.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Alright. Anything else before we wrap?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: No, that's the one.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Okay. I'll follow up by Tuesday. Thanks, both.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Thanks, [PERSON_1].

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Morning, [PERSON_1]. How's it going out there in Denver?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Morning, [PERSON_2]. Pretty good, busy week. How about you?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Same here. I wanted to walk through where we are with the onboarding and lock down a few dates. Do you have about twenty minutes?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Yeah, I've got the time. I've got the calendar open.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Perfect. So first thing, the Genesys side. I know your team was getting the screen pop configured last week. Where did that land?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: It's set up in the test environment. We're doing a small pilot with a handful of sales reps starting Monday.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Okay, good. And who's the lead on that from your side?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: [PERSON_3]'s running the pilot, she owns the sales floor tech.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Got it. I'll make sure she has my contact info in case anything comes up during the pilot week.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That would help. She'll probably have questions about the routing piece.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Sure. Now the training dates. We talked about doing two sessions for the call tracking admins. Are we still thinking the first week of November?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: First week works, but Tuesday is a holiday for some of the team. Could we do Wednesday and Thursday?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Wednesday and Thursday, the fourth and fifth. What time works? We did ten in the past.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Ten is fine. That gives people time to get through the morning queue first.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: I'll send the invites today. Should I include the whole admin group or just the two who are taking over the day to day?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Include everyone. A couple of people are just watching, but they like to sit in.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: No problem. How many should I expect on the invite?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Probably eight. Maybe nine.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Okay. Next, user changes. I saw a ticket come through about adding a few seats on the messaging side. Is that still in motion?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Yes, we're adding four seats for the seasonal push. Should be finalized by the end of the month.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Good. I'll keep an eye out and confirm once they're active. Anything else changing on the account side?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Not really. We're heading into the busy stretch with the holiday campaigns, so mostly just volume.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Makes sense. Do you expect the call volume to shift much week over week?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Probably up a bit starting mid-November, then it settles after the first of the year.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Good to know. If it gets heavy I can check in more often. Otherwise we'll keep the monthly cadence.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Monthly is fine for now.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Last thing, the reporting walkthrough for Adobe. Do you want that bundled into the November sessions or separate?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Separate, I think. The admins will be maxed out that week.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Okay, I'll look at the week after and send some options.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Sounds good.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That's everything on my list. I'll get the invites and the Adobe options over by end of day.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Perfect. Thanks, [PERSON_2].

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Thanks, [PERSON_1]. Talk soon.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Frontier Home Lending · Escalation · October 23, 2026

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: **Attendees:** [PERSON_1] Williams (Director, Contact Center Ops, Frontier Home Lending); [PERSON_2] (CSM, Invoca)

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Summary

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_1] raised two issues he says his team is hitting in production. We walked through what they are seeing and when it started. He wants them logged and routed before the November push.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Discussion

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Volume is holding around 61,000 calls a month, up about 6% since Labor Day. Refi inbound is the growth.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: 22 new loan officers through the Five9 queue starting November 2, floor space is ready, headsets and licensing ordered.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Salesforce Loan Application object is still the system of record for outcomes. [PERSON_4]'s team owns the field changes on their side.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_1] noted the Houston team runs a different after-hours schedule, so his numbers exclude that site.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Briefly asked about cadence into year end. Agreed to keep the monthly check-in and add a short one before the November [PERSON_3].

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Product feedback

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: "When [PERSON_4]'s team added a field to our Loan Application object, the Salesforce sync just stopped writing call records to the custom objects. No error on our end, we only caught it because a manager said his dashboard looked thin."

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: "On our new single-page application, once the borrower moves past the first step, dynamic number insertion stops swapping the number. Calls from the new checkout are landing in Google Ads as direct traffic."

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Risks

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: If the Salesforce sync stays down, call outcomes won't reach the Loan Application objects and reporting for the November [PERSON_3] will be incomplete.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Misattributed checkout calls could distort Google Ads bidding during a high-volume stretch.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Next steps

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] to log both items and send [PERSON_1] the case numbers by end of day October 23.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] to pull the sync error history and the DNI tag behavior on the SPA and share findings by October 27.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_1] to send [PERSON_2] the field change [PERSON_4]'s team made and the URL path for the new checkout by October 26.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] to [PERSON_3] a 30-minute pre-[PERSON_3] check-in for the week of October 26.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: Atlas Auto Group / Invoca | escalation | Fri, Oct 23, 2026

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: [PERSON_1], thanks for making time on short notice. I wanted to talk through something that's been sitting with me for a couple of weeks.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Of course, [PERSON_2]. I appreciate you calling. What's going on?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: So Marchex has been in front of our dealer group principals. They're quoting a lower per-rooftop price than what we're paying you, and in some of the packages they're throwing call scoring in at no extra cost. They're also offering free months to switch. It's aggressive, and our CFO is asking me why we wouldn't at least look at it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Okay. When did that start, and is it coming through your office or directly to the individual rooftop GMs?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Mostly through me and through our VP of Fixed Ops. A couple of the GMs in Nevada got calls too. I've been holding them off, but the December renewal is on everyone's calendar now.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Got it. I'm not going to try to solve pricing on this call. What I want to do is get the details documented and bring it to our team so we can come back to you with something concrete.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That's fair. I'd rather have that than a pitch right now.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Before we get into it, how did the month close out on call volume? Last time we talked you were running around 38,000 calls a month across the rooftops.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: We're at about 41,000 for October. Phoenix and Tucson are up, and the Henderson store has been busy since they started the new radio spots.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That's good to hear. Anything on the BDC side I should know about?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: We lost two BDC reps in the Tempe store, so their follow-up is behind. [PERSON_3] is covering until they hire. It's not an Invoca thing, just staffing.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Understood. If it helps, I can send [PERSON_3] a short refresher on pulling call recordings for coaching while they're short-handed. No charge, just something I put together.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That would actually help. She's been asking about it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: I'll get that over Monday. Now, back to Marchex. Do you have the quote in writing?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: I have a summary deck. Per rooftop it's roughly fifteen percent below our current rate, and they're saying three months free if we sign before the end of the year.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: And that includes call scoring?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That's what they told our Fixed Ops guy. I haven't seen the fine print on what the scoring actually covers.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Okay. Can you send me the deck? I'll get it in front of our team with the renewal context so they can look at it properly.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: I'll forward it this afternoon. I want to be clear, [PERSON_1], I'm not looking to leave. But when someone walks in with a lower number and free months, I have to bring it to leadership.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That's completely reasonable, and I'd do the same. What I'd ask is that we get a chance to respond before anyone makes a decision.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: You'll get that. The principals meet the first week of November, so anything you have before then is useful.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That gives me about a week and a half. Let me ask a couple more things so I'm not guessing. Is the comparison strictly on price, or are they also questioning what you're getting from us?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: It's mostly price. Our marketing team still uses the call data every week for Google Ads and for the Salesforce leads, and nobody's complaining about that.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Good. And how are the Signal AI classifications holding up? Any categories you've stopped trusting?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: They're fine. We use appointment booked and quote given the most, and those have been consistent.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Okay. I'll leave that alone then. One more question on the Marchex piece. Did they put a number on the free months, or is it open-ended?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Three months, and they said it applies to the per-rooftop fee. I don't know how they'd handle the setup across twenty-two stores.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That's a good question to ask them. I'll note it. Anything else from the principals I should know about?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Not really. Our controller asked whether the renewal date could move, and I told her probably not, but I said I'd ask.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: I can ask on our side, though I don't want to promise anything. December 1 is the date we're working from.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That's what I figured. Just wanted to close the loop with her.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: So here's what I'll do. I'll send you a short summary of this call today, you forward the Marchex deck, and I'll take both to our team early next week. I'll come back to you by Thursday with either an answer or a clear next step.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Thursday works. I'll get you the deck within the hour.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Perfect. And [PERSON_2], thanks for telling me directly instead of letting it sit. That helps.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Appreciate it, [PERSON_1]. Talk Thursday.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Talk Thursday. Have a good weekend.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: Atlas Auto Group / Invoca | QBR | Fri, Oct 23, 2026

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Hey [PERSON_1], hey [PERSON_2]. Thanks for making time. How's Friday treating you both?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Busy. End of the month is close, so we're chasing numbers. But good to see you, [PERSON_3].

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Hi [PERSON_3]. I've got about thirty minutes before I need to jump on something with the BDC team, so we should dig in.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: That works. I want to walk through Q3 volume and what we're seeing in Signal AI, then leave room for whatever's on your list.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Sounds good.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: So across the 22 rooftops, you tracked about 61,000 calls in Q3. Up roughly 9% over Q2. Phoenix stores carried most of that.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That tracks. We added two BDC reps in Tempe in August, so the call handling is better than it was in the spring.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: I saw the appointment-booked signal rate move from 31% to 34%. Is that the extra reps, or something else?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Mostly the reps. We also tightened the script for service-to-sales transfers, which helped.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: And the Las Vegas stores have been flat. We're putting more spend behind Henderson in Q4.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Got it. Anything on the Signal AI side you want to look at? New signals, tuning?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Signals have been fine. No complaints there.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Yeah, the custom signals we built for trade-in and financing are doing what we need.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Good. And the Salesforce lead records?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Those are fine, too.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: [PERSON_3], before we get too far, can we talk about the Google Ads side? [PERSON_2]'s been raising something with me.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Of course. What's going on?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: So the offline call conversions we send to Google Ads, they're landing one to three days after the call. Google shows them eventually, but by then the day is gone.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Are you seeing them in the Google Ads UI, just late, or not at all?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: They show up. It's the timing. My team is making daily budget calls on which campaigns to push, and we can't see the call conversions for two or three days, so Smart Bidding is optimizing on incomplete data.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: We're moving money around based on a picture that's still filling in. That's the part that worries me.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: When did you first notice the lag?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: It's been like this for a while, but it got more noticeable when we ramped spend in September. I flagged it to our Google rep, and they said the conversions are coming through, just delayed.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Okay. I want to get the specifics. Is it every campaign, or certain ones?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Mostly the new-vehicle campaigns. Service is less of an issue because we're not bidding as aggressively there.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Let me pull the conversion timestamps from the last two weeks and take it to our integrations team. I don't want to guess at what's happening.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Appreciate that. I can send you a couple of campaign IDs where it's worst.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Please do. And I'll follow up by Wednesday with what I find out.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That's all we're asking. We just need to know if it's on our end or yours.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Understood. Let me also ask, is anything else on the tracking side giving you trouble?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: No, the tracking numbers and the tag have been solid.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Same. No issues there.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Good. One logistics thing: our next QBR would land in late January. Does that work, or do you want to move it after the first of the year?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Late January is fine. Let's aim for the 26th or so.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Works for me. I'll have my team pull the Q4 numbers beforehand.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: I'll send the invite and a prep doc. Anything else before we wrap?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That's it from me. Thanks, [PERSON_3].

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: I'll get you those campaign IDs this afternoon.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Perfect. Talk soon, both.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Hey [PERSON_1], hey [PERSON_2]. Like, How's Phoenix treating you? Still triple uh, digits down there?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Oh, we hit 102 yesterday. In October. My wife keeps asking why we don't move to Flagstaff.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: And I've got two BDC reps out with the flu this week, so the phones have been chaos. But um, we're managing.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Oof. Uh, yeah, that's rough. Well, I know you both have a hard stop around five, so let me just say this is our renewal check in.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: December first is the date. I want to hear what's working and what's not before we get into any paperwork.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Appreciate that. So, top line, the call tracking is doing what it's supposed to. We're tracking about 18,000 calls a month across the 22 rooftops now.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Google Ads and Meta are both feeding in, Salesforce is getting the BDC leads.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: 18,000, that's up from what, 15 last quarter?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Yeah, we added the Henderson store in August, so that's part of it. Attribution looks right, the BDC team isn't complaining.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Signal AI is fine, the appointment booked signal is matching what we see in the CRM pretty closely.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Good, good. So what's on your mind for the the renewal?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Honestly? The money. Finance and procurement have been all over me. They look at the invoice and they see call tracking, and then they see Signal AI as a separate line, and then whatever else gets bolted on.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: And they're asking why we're paying for things piece by piece instead of one you know, number per rooftop.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: It's not just [PERSON_1]'s team. When procurement sees Signal AI priced as an add-on on top of call tracking, they start questioning the whole stack.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: The way they see it, the platform should just include the intelligence part. They don't want to be nickel and dimed at renewal.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Okay, so, when you say add-ons, is it Signal AI specifically, like, or is it the way the whole bill is structured?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Both. But Signal AI is the one that gets circled. It's the line item they point at and say, why is this extra?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: And I'll be straight with you, [PERSON_3]. We've started taking calls from other vendors. Marchex has been in my inbox. Their per rooftop number comes in lower than what we're paying now, and procurement has seen that quote.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Got it. And is that a real evaluation or is it procurement doing their usual thing?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: It's real enough so, that I have to bring them something. I'm not saying we're leaving, um, but the the like, renewal decision is tied to whether this add-on pricing friction gets resolved.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That's the honest answer.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: I appreciate you saying that straight. Let me ask a couple things so I can take it back to my team properly.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: When you say per rooftop, is Marchex quoting you the same 22 locations, or are they cherry picking the bigger stores?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: All 22. Though I'd want to see the contract before I believed it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Fair. And [PERSON_2], on the Signal AI side, is the concern purely the line item, or is there something about how it's being used that's driving this?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: No, usage is fine. It's purely how it shows up on the bill. If it were baked into the per rooftop rate, procurement wouldn't have a leg to stand on.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Okay. That's helpful. I don't want to promise anything on this call, because I can't restructure pricing by myself, but I can take the specific ask to my leadership.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: What I'd want to bring them is: what would need to be true for you to sign in December?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: A single per rooftop number that covers what we use, no separate add-on lines. That's the cleanest version.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: And if there has to be a separate line, at least make it predictable. Right now every renewal it feels like something new gets added on.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Okay. Let me write that down exactly. One bundled per rooftop rate, or if not, no new add-on lines at renewal.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: I'll get that in front of my director this week.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That works. And [PERSON_3], just so you know, I'm not trying to play hardball. I'd rather stay. The team knows the system.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: I hear that that. And look, on the operational side, anything else I should know? Volumes, routing, anything weird?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Nothing weird. The Henderson store is still getting used to the call flow, but that's a training thing, um, not a platform thing.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: We're doing a refresher with the the reps next Tuesday.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Okay, I can send you the flow diagram if that helps.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That would actually be great. Send it to my work email, not the BDC distro.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Will do. Alright, I'll let you both go. [PERSON_1], I'll follow up by Wednesday with whatever I hear. [PERSON_2], diagram coming today.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Sounds good. Thanks [PERSON_3].

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Thanks. And stay out of the sun this weekend.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Ha, I'm in Chicago, but I'll pass that along to my lawn. Talk soon.
